prose: A short antirez post titled 'Vector Sets are part of Redis.' Only the title was captured, so this summary rests on it alone.

On that basis: Sanfilippo - Redis's creator, back at the project - announces that Vector Sets, his new data type for vector similarity, has landed in Redis proper. Version, API and availability details are unknown from the capture.
highlights: antirez: Vector Sets are now part of Redis
Vector similarity becomes a native Redis data type
Notable given Sanfilippo's return to the project he created
Title only; version and API details unknown
